facts.text: Founded in 1856, Wilberforce University is the nation's first private Historically Black College and University owned and operated by African Americans.

sources.title: FACULTY HANDBOOK - Wilberforce University
sources.quote: Wilberforce University is the nation's first, private, Historically Black College and University (HBCU) owned and operated by African Americans. Its roots trace back to its founding in 1856
